column1: # Pilot 5b (2026-10-10): replication of pilot 5 on a second task, generalized_eigenvalues_real, at $2 per agent to fit
# the remaining Anthropic credit (~$27). Same settings otherwise: Claude Opus 5.5 effort xhigh, run to budget (submit
# refused below 80% spend), 16 h backstop, 1 h cache, 4 CPUs per agent, remote scorer. Arms: team of 4, team of 2,
# 6 independent agents (best-of-2 and best-of-4 resampling). Max model spend $24 (min about $19 at 80%).
